waves.root_cause: Relay fuel-card swipes (imported to fuel.fuel_transactions via Relay API) are posted to GL by the fuel_event poster. The SAME purchases also appear as bank debits (RELAY*/Love's ACH settlements) in banking.bank_transactions, which are then categorized to the same fuel expense GL accounts (6100 Fuel Expense, QBO-155 Fuel-Def, QBO-92 Fuel-Reefer-Diesel). Both paths debit fuel expense → GL fuel is overstated by the bank-categorized amount. Settlement-level matching confirms: Relay settles per-charge to the checking account, so each bank debit corresponds to one or more fuel card swipes already posted by the fuel poster.

instances.note: Total double-posted: $9,216.49 (18 bank txns). Each corresponds to Relay fuel-card swipes already in fuel.fuel_transactions and posted by the fuel_event poster to the same GL accounts.

instances.path: 50 OTHER_FUEL bank debits (FUEL AMERICA, ExxonMobil, Laredo Bridge, Pilot, Road Ranger, Murphy Express) totaling $3,615.76 — these are NON-Relay fuel purchases NOT present in fuel.fuel_transactions. They are legitimate bank-only fuel GL entries (no overlap with fuel poster). NOT double-counted.
instances.note: These 50 represent corporate-card or cash fuel purchases outside the Relay/Love's fleet card. Correctly categorized to fuel GL. No remediation needed.

waves.completeness: lucia-bypass Neon prod 2026-08-03: fuel.fuel_transactions sum=$625,546.39 (1,547 txns, ALL source=other, ALL relay_bridge=1, ALL merchant=Love's). GL fuel debit from fuel_event poster=$625,546.39 (1,547 JE posting lines). GL fuel debit from bank_categorization=$48,028.41 (165 lines across all periods). Total GL fuel expense=$673,574.80 vs actual fuel card spend=$625,546.39 → overstated by $48,028.41. Breakdown: $34,887.16 (98 txns) pre-Mar-3 bank-only (legit, no fuel poster existed yet); $9,216.49 (18 txns) overlap RELAY/Love's = TRUE DOUBLE; $3,615.76 (50 txns) overlap non-Love's = legit bank-only. NET DOUBLE-COUNT: $9,216.49.
